description: A Kotlin class defining an Android Fragment (HomeFragment) for a TV app. It sets up a main screen that includes a top navigation bar (implemented via Jetpack Compose), hero banner, 'Continue Watching' rail, and TV Channels rail. The class manages UI setup, data loading via ViewModel and repositories, observe state changes, displays loading indicators, and handles focus and layout considerations suitable for Android TV. It also includes detailed layout and styling specifications, focusing on focus management, overscan-safe padding, and positioning.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment representing the main home screen; manages UI layout, user interactions, focus, loading states, and integration with ViewModel for data fetching.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates and returns the root view hierarchy, setting up the scroll view, containers, and section layouts including Compose TopNavBar, hero banner, and content rails.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets initial focus and starts observing ViewModel states.

methods.name: observeViewModelStates
methods.description: Sets up LiveData observers to update UI based on loading, success, or error states.

methods.name: showContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Displays loading indicator for Continue Watching section.

methods.name: hideContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Hides loading indicator for Continue Watching section.

methods.name: showTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Displays loading indicator for TV Channels section.

methods.name: hideTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Hides loading indicator for TV Channels section.

methods.name: showErrorWithRetry
methods.description: Displays error message and triggers a retry after a delay.

methods.name: updateContinueWatchingRail
methods.description: Populates Continue Watching rail with fetched data.

methods.name: updateTvChannelsRail
methods.description: Populates TV Channels rail with fetched data.

methods.name: addComposeTopNavBar
methods.description: Adds the Compose-based top navigation bar with specified positioning.

methods.name: setupHeroBanner
methods.description: Creates the hero/banner section with fixed height and position.

methods.name: setupContinueWatchingSection
methods.description: Creates the 'Seguí viendo' section with horizontal rail and loading indicator.

methods.name: setupTvChannelsSection
methods.description: Creates the 'Canales de TV' section with horizontal rail and loading indicator.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Converts density-independent pixels to pixels based on device density.
